security.csp: default-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; img-src 'self' archive: http://archive.localhost asset: data: blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Import and browse an iPhone's data.
bundle.longDescription: Archive imports photos, messages, contacts, notes, calendars, health data and more from an iPhone backup, and lets you browse them on a desktop.
